name: Plot response function
summary: Renders the single-fiber response function of a CSD fit on a sphere as a PNG image with DIPY/VTK, for quality control of the response estimate.
description: Reads response.txt from a CSD output (using the second row when several rows are present), builds an axially symmetric spherical-harmonic response with DIPY and renders it on the symmetric724 sphere off-screen (Xvfb). Use it to check that the response looks like a flat, disc-shaped single-fiber profile; the README shows good versus bad examples.

inputs.description: The path to the CSD datatype containing the response function

outputs.description: A png of the response function mapped to a sphere

citations.text: Avesani P, McPherson B, Hayashi S, et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).
